[EN] What's Yours Is Mine
[ES] Lo tuyo es mío
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm tired of waking up and feeling hunger pangs.
[ES] Estoy cansado de despertarme y sentir punzadas de hambre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] These supplies will go a long way. Thank you.
[ES] Estos suministros servirán de mucho. Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you...I think."
[ES] "Gracias... supongo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect supplies from the eastern Daunting Pass.
[ES] Recoge suministros del este de Daunting Pass.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the supplies to Morva.
[ES] Entrega los suministros a Morva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
